nav:
Bajaj Finserv Nifty 50 Index Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Bajaj Finserv Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 17 Oct 2021. Ilesh Savla is the Current Fund Manager of Bajaj Finserv Nifty 50 Index Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹33,660 Cr and the Latest  as of 09 Jul 2026 is ₹9.77.
The Bajaj Finserv Nifty 50 Index Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹500. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹5,000.
